correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 24 necessary constraints for right evaluation through degree five, including 2b_2=2b_3=0. The independently authored replay reviews/evidence/review1_certificate.py (Python 3 with SymPy) returned det=4096 and Smith diagonal consisting of twelve 1s and twelve 2s. Unimodular column transformations are invertible modulo four and preserve entrywise evenness, so the kernel modulo four of the necessary constraints has only even coordinates. For F=2G, the reduction of G may have arbitrary matrix coefficients, but test inputs and right multipliers reduce to lower triangular matrices. In each coefficient row (u,v), triangular evaluation imposes point vanishing of both scalar polynomials at 0 and 1 plus vanishing of the divided-difference sums for v. Multiplication by a lower triangular constant maps (u,v) to (alpha u+gamma v, delta v), preserving all these conditions (also when the diagonal entries of the test input coincide). Central powers preserve nullity by multiplying the evaluation on the right by the same input power. This handles every polynomial multiplier. The independent replay checked the displayed sextic at all 128 inputs and returned the nonzero value 2E21 for the right multiple at the displayed r. The lower bound is exhaustive by the constraint argument, not a search over a sample of polynomials. The supplied checker and its recorded output were inspected, not executed.
